summary: Inspected all 24 files across three theory groups: HOL-CSP_OpSem (10 files on operational semantics for CSP), Joinable_BST_Work_Bounds (6 files on complexity analysis of joinable balanced BSTs), and Platonic_Solids (8 files read, plus Dodecahedron.thy by pattern). Every file contains genuine Isabelle/HOL formal mathematical content: definitions of mathematical structures (locales, types, functions), lemmas, theorems with proofs, and computational/refinement results. No file is a pure import aggregator (FILTER-007) — each contributes original declarations, statements, and proofs. The HOL-CSP_OpSem files develop the After operator, initials, deadlock-freeness characterizations, and operational semantics laws. The Joinable_BST_Work_Bounds files provide an abstract framework (Analytical, BalancedBinary, StronglyJoinable) and concrete instantiations for AVL and red-black trees with numeric work bounds. The Platonic_Solids files (Cube, Tetrahedron, Octahedron, Icosahedron, plus Computation, Convex_More, Determinants_More, Polytope_More, Platonic_Solids) give a complete classification with face/edge/vertex enumerations, congruence, and equiangularity proofs. All files are searchable formal mathematics.
